title: Test — Kundalik hayot va o'qish ko'nikmasi

questions.explanation: Scanning esa — aniq ma'lumotni (sana, ism, raqam) topish.

questions.text: Extensive reading da notanish so'z uchraganda nima qilish kerak?
options: Kontekstdan taxmin qilib, oqib o'qishni davom ettirish
questions.explanation: Har so'zni qarash o'qish tezligini va zavqini yo'qotadi.
do the housework/dishes/laundry; make the bed/a meal; have a shower/break.
have a shower (BrE) / take a shower (AmE) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
Bo'sh vaqt: hang out, work out, scroll, binge-watch, catch up, chill.
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish — Present Continuous.

questions.text: «She ___ (go) to Paris last year» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Past Simple, irregular: go → went.

questions.text: «This is ___ film I've ever seen» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Orttirma daraja doim «the» bilan; good → the best.
mustn't — ta'qiq; don't have to — shart emas.
information — sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun much.

options: mine otsiz ishlatiladi: my book yoki It's mine
questions.explanation: Egalik olmoshi (mine, yours, hers) otdan keyin turmaydi.
«a my friend» xato — to'g'risi: a friend of mine.
O'zlik olmoshi ta'kid uchun ham ishlatiladi. by myself — yolg'iz.

options: each other — bir-birini; themselves — har biri o'zini
questions.explanation: They looked at each other ≠ They looked at themselves (oynada).

questions.text: «I feel myself good» — bu nega xato?
options: feel o'zlik olmoshi olmaydi: I feel good
questions.explanation: O'zlik olmaydigan fe'llar: feel, relax, concentrate, meet, get dressed.

title: Test — Verb + ing / to va -ed/-ing sifatlar

questions.explanation: Fe'l + -ing: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, can't stand, miss.
Fe'l + to: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, learn, manage, agree.

questions.text: «stop smoking» va «stop to smoke» qanday farqlanadi?
options: stop -ing — tashlamoq; stop to — ... uchun to'xtamoq
questions.explanation: Shunga o'xshash: remember/forget -ing (o'tmish) ↔ to (kelajak vazifa).
PREDLOGdan keyin DOIM -ing: interested in learning, look forward to seeing.
-ed — his (odam): I'm bored; -ing — manba (narsa): The film is boring.

questions.text: «used to» dan keyin qanday fe'l keladi?
questions.explanation: I used to play football — o'tmish odati yoki holati (endi yo'q).
Savolda ham: Did you use to...?

questions.text: «used to do» va «be used to doing» qanday farqlanadi?
options: used to do — o'tmish odati; be used to doing — ko'nikkan (hozir)
questions.explanation: I used to live here (ilgari) ≠ I'm used to living here (ko'nikkanman).

questions.text: Bitta martalik yutuq haqida gapirganda qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: could — umumiy qobiliyat; bitta konkret holatda «was able to».
It could/may/might rain — taxmin; might eng kam ishonch.
He is in the room ↔ He walked into the room. on ↔ onto.

questions.text: «___ the forest» (o'rmon ichidan o'tib) — qaysi predlog?
questions.explanation: across — ochiq sirt (road, bridge); through — ichidan (forest, tunnel, door).

options: to — manzilga yetadi; towards — tomonga qarab
questions.explanation: I went to the station ↔ I walked towards the station.
arrive IN (shahar/mamlakat), arrive AT (aniq joy). «arrive to» — xato.
get on/off — avtobus, poyezd, samolyot; get into/out of — mashina.

questions.text: «If you heat ice, it ___ » — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Zero conditional (doimiy haqiqat): If + present, present.

questions.text: «If it rains, I ___ home» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: First conditional (real kelajak): If + present, will + fe'l.

questions.text: «If it will rain...» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: If it rains, ... — bu A2 ning eng muhim qoidasi.
Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry.
Teskari tartibda esa vergul qo'yilmaydi: I'll stay home if it rains.
Telefonda o'zini tanishtirish: This is Ali. Kim so'raganda: Who's calling?
Telefon tili: the line's busy, wrong number, you're breaking up.
Yo'l: turn left/right, go past/across/along, It's on your left.
Yo'l ko'rsatishning odatiy yakuniy iborasi.
I have a cold/temperature; My ... hurts; a pain in my ... Get well soon!
